headline: Mod-GRF 1-29
punch: The accelerator that does not wear out.

headline: What it actually is
body: A 29-amino-acid GHRH analogue with four substitutions, D-Ala2, Gln8, Ala15 and Leu27, engineered for stability against enzymatic breakdown. | It binds the GHRH receptor on your pituitary somatotrophs and signals through **Gs and cAMP**, which is the amplitude pathway. Its half-life is roughly **30 minutes**, which sets the window in which it can co-stimulate with anything else.
punch: A short, sharp push on the amplitude lever.

headline: It does not desensitise
body: This is the single most useful fact about this compound and it separates it from the entire GHRP class. **Fourteen days of continuous GHRH infusion did not desensitise** the pituitary. | Compare that to twenty-four hours of continuous GHRP infusion, which attenuated the response to a subsequent bolus. The GHRH receptor is not the rate-limiting component. The ghrelin receptor is.
punch: ==14 days continuous and the receptor still answered.==

headline: It multiplies with a GHRP
body: Because GHRH and ghrelin receptors run on separate wiring, Gs/cAMP against Gq/PLC, the two genuinely multiply rather than overlap. | A GHS given together with GHRH exerts a **synergistic action**, and that combination is described in the literature as **the most potent GH releaser to date**. It became the gold standard test of GH reserve precisely because the response is not blunted by gender, adiposity or age.
punch: The strongest known way to make a pituitary release GH.

headline: Do not confuse it with DAC
body: CJC-1295 **with** DAC binds albumin and extends half-life to **6 to 8 days**, producing continuous GHRH receptor occupancy. That is mechanistically the opposite of what this compound does. | Everything in the pulsatility literature says continuous delivery produces higher IGF-1 and less growth. A 6-to-8-day continuous GHRH signal is the delivery pattern Bick showed loses to pulses at the same dose.
punch: ==No DAC and with DAC are opposite drugs.==

headline: It is still gated
body: GHRH analogues have no mechanism to suppress somatostatin themselves, which makes them more timing-sensitive to ambient somatostatin tone than GHRP-containing protocols are. | And the GH response to GHRH **is dependent on somatostatin tone**, measured directly in humans by Spoudeas. Infuse somatostatin underneath and the first response is blunted and the second is blunted further.
punch: No amount of GHRH gets past a closed gate.

headline: Time it to the trough
body: If the limit is somatostatin tone, the lever is when you use it rather than how much. Around **70%** of daily GH comes out in early sleep, during the window when somatostatin has naturally withdrawn. | And the one thing that reliably lowers somatostatin in humans is cholinergic tone or arginine, both of which have been used as research probes for exactly this.
punch: Timing beats dose on this compound.

headline: Pair it, do not stack it
body: The co-stimulation window is set by the 30-minute half-life, so a GHRP and this have to arrive close together to get the synergy rather than two separate smaller pulses. | And because the GHRH arm does not fatigue while the ghrelin arm does, the component you would cycle or rest is the GHRP, not this one. That asymmetry is measured, not assumed.
punch: Rest the GHRP. The GHRH arm does not need it.

headline: No outcome trial
body: Everything above is pharmacology: receptor behaviour, desensitisation kinetics, GH release. All measured, mostly in humans, and solid. | There is no trial of this compound against height, bone, or any clinical endpoint. Secretagogues as a class raise endogenous pulsatile GH within a roughly physiological envelope, do not exceed exogenous GH's effect on linear growth, and cannot reopen a fused plate.

headline: Verdict
body: Mechanistically the cleanest compound in this axis. It pushes the amplitude lever, it does not fatigue over two weeks of continuous exposure, and it synergises with the ghrelin arm for genuine multiplicative reasons. | Its ceiling is somatostatin tone rather than dose, its effect is bounded by physiological GH release, and the DAC version is a different drug that should not be substituted.
punch: The accelerator that holds. Still bounded by the brake.
